description: Search for actors, directors, or crew by name, or get full filmography by person ID (TMDB)

id.description: TMDB person ID for detailed filmography (e.g. 31 for Tom Hanks). Use either id or query

page.description: Page number for search results (1-500, default 1)

query.description: Person name to search for (e.g. "Tom Hanks", "Miyazaki"). Use either query or id

name: tmdb.movies.person

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Person / Filmography
